findings.claim: Repo.Validate now rejects the names default/archived, and readRegistrySnapshot validates every stored entry, so an existing repos.json that already registers a repo named default or archived (legal before this change: namePattern admits both) becomes wholly unreadable — Reload fails, and every Add and Remove fails, instead of only new adds of the reserved names being refused.
findings.evidence: Re-read registry.go: Validate L35-58 adds the reserved-name check at L48; readRegistrySnapshot L244-253 calls repo.Validate() on every file entry and returns an error on the first failure; Reload L170-174, Add L139-142 and Remove L187-190 all go through readRegistrySnapshot and propagate that error. Base version (git diff) had no reserved-name check, and namePattern ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ is unchanged, so {"repos":[{"name":"default","path":"/x"}]} loaded fine at base and now fails with 'Repo.Validate: Invalid field Name: "default" is reserved'. refreshIfChanged keeps the last good state only after a successful earlier load; at startup there is none. No migration of such entries exists in the diff for this chunk.
findings.fix: Apply the reserved-name rule only at Registry.Add (new registrations) — e.g. move the default/archived check out of Validate into Add, or have readRegistrySnapshot skip-and-log reserved legacy entries instead of failing the whole file.

findings.claim: policyBase decides the vacuous case by branch name (checked-out branch == base branch name), not by the spec's 'HEAD at the base tip passes vacuously': an agent branch whose HEAD equals the base tip with uncommitted surface edits is gated, and a local base branch ahead of origin is still treated as the base. This is a deliberate deviation (code comment L190-192) that is stricter than correctness-57 and closer to spec D4 'agent worktrees can never self-escalate'; recorded so the spec owner confirms it.
findings.evidence: Re-read policy.go L189-219: isBoundary = branch != strings.TrimPrefix(baseName, "origin/"); no comparison of HEAD to the base tip exists. spec-6 L226-227 sketches 'isBoundary is false when HEAD == base tip'. With HEAD on claude/x at the main tip and an uncommitted edit to acdsl/registry.json in gated mode, surfaceDelta flags it, while the spec's literal rule would pass vacuously.
